cameraContract.artPerspective: three-quarter top-down RPG on a square grid
cameraContract.canvasPolicy: Species-specific square canvas with padding; orthoScale = canvasWidth / pixelsPerWorldUnit. Ground-origin anchor and camera shift are recorded per species. Never resize an exported animal to fit its cell.
cameraContract.calibration: Coordinator inspected 30/40/50 degree studies and the revised fox beside exact Modern Exteriors roof/tree/cars and Explorer. 40 degrees gives readable upper back and separated limb depths. This is an artistic fit, not a claimed mathematical camera measurement of painted vendor art.
